meta.title: Persona Routing Hub
meta.description: Multi-bot persona routing across platforms: web default persona plus per-bot, per-channel and per-target bindings.

ui.assets.delConfirm: Delete persona “{key}”? This cannot be undone.
ui.assets.delInUseAsk: Forcing the delete leaves those references pointing at a missing persona (shown as “unnamed”). Delete anyway?
ui.assets.delShipped: Shipped personas cannot be deleted; import with overwrite instead.
ui.assets.delMissing: Persona not found (it may already be deleted). Refresh and retry.
ui.imp.title: Import persona
ui.imp.name: Display name
ui.imp.rules: Format: UTF-8 plain text (.txt / .md, no front matter, no YAML), 200000 characters max; key rule ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ (lowercase letter first, 32 characters max).
ui.imp.keyInvalid: Invalid key: start with a lowercase letter, only a-z0-9_-, 32 characters max.
ui.imp.textEmpty: Empty text: the file has no body to import.
ui.imp.exists: That key already exists; tick “Overwrite same key” and retry.
ui.imp.existsShipped: A shipped persona already uses that key; tick “Overwrite same key” and retry (creates a user copy).
